author: Martin Shaw
text: I’ve had three fail this week all being replaced

author: Ronald Murchison
text: When I get one that fails with more than 5 days left, I call in and do fingersticks until I get my replacement. That way I never run out of sensors and get extended time on the ones I already have. I just got a refill on 6 while I already had a box of 6. Keep a supply of strips, and I have a lot, have a system, and you'll never run out. Being totally dependent on the sensors aren't a requirement, so to be going through them so quickly, you'll never have any and eventually Abbott will stop replacing them and you're back to finger sticking anyway.
